Analytics Launch Control

This page keeps website analytics, privacy notice, consent, UTM, and conversion checks visible for every public launch.

Baseline: privacy-first analytics

Default Rule

Use Cloudflare aggregate analytics plus first-party CRM, invite, registration, and partner request records. Do not add ad pixels, retargeting, session replay, fingerprinting, or non-essential cookies without the consent and review workflow.

Privacy notice Setup checklist Admin tracker

Launch Gate

Run this before each campaign page, event page, registration funnel, sponsor page, booking path, or tracking change ships:

node scripts/check-website-analytics-privacy.mjs

A failure blocks launch unless Robert, Jodi, or Scott explicitly accepts the exception.

Owner Memory

  1. Jodi tags campaign links with UTMs.
  2. Scott confirms the launch gate passes.
  3. Robert reviews privacy and consent if tracking changes.
  4. Jodi reviews registration source and conversion after launch.

What Is Captured

Member, guest, partner, and partner subscription submissions preserve sanitized source attribution in first-party records when UTMs are present.

  • utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign
  • utm_content, utm_term
  • landing path and referring host

Do Not Forget

Every per-event checklist should include the analytics launch checklist, UTM plan, privacy review, and launch-gate command. If paid media, retargeting, or third-party pixels enter the plan, stop and add consent before those tools load.
